audit_title: Phase 7 Audit of Phase 6 Inconsistencies and Baseline Verification

phase6_recommended_operating_point.ensemble_architecture: YAMNet Quad Stacking Ensemble (Keras + CatBoost + LightGBM + XGBoost)

discrepancy_reconciliation_threshold_069.issue_statement: At threshold 0.690, Phase 6 report contained two differing figures: 1) 12 alerts, 103.43 alerts/hr, 57.14% event precision (in Section 2 audit); 2) 13 alerts, 112.05 alerts/hr, 55.17% event precision (in Section 7 final grid).

root_cause_diagnosis.mechanism: Cooldown State Machine Transition between Phase 5 and Phase 6

phase5_unconditional_cooldown.logic: cooldown_until = prev_et + cooldown_secs (unconditionally locked out for 2.0s after previous window end)
phase5_unconditional_cooldown.behavior_on_laser_file: File 'freesound_community-laser-compilation-05-31597' has two distinct laser bursts at 13.44s and 14.88s. The second burst (at 14.88s) was suppressed by the unconditional cooldown lockout from the first burst (ended at 14.88s).
phase5_unconditional_cooldown.flaw: This unconditional lockout also suppressed genuine rapid-fire gunshots occurring 1.0 - 1.5s apart.

phase6_adaptive_refractory_cooldown.logic: Preserves subsequent onsets if audio decayed below threshold_off (had_decayed = True and score >= threshold)
phase6_adaptive_refractory_cooldown.behavior_on_laser_file: Between the two synthetic laser bursts, audio dropped below threshold_off (score < 0.40). The adaptive logic recognized the second burst (14.88s - 16.32s) as a separate onset, preserving it.
phase6_adaptive_refractory_cooldown.benefit: Correctly preserves genuine closely spaced physical gunshot events (e.g. semi-automatic bursts), as verified by regression test 6.

discrepancy_reconciliation_threshold_069.conclusion: The 12-alert / 103.43/hr / 57.14% figure was the historical Phase 5 baseline reproduction under unconditional cooldown. The 13-alert / 112.05/hr / 55.17% figure is the true programmatic output of the Phase 6 adaptive refractory codebase. Both figures are mathematically accounted for, and the true operating baseline for Phase 7 is the 13-alert (112.05/hr) point.
